label: Empirical Dataset
description: Requires a real empirical dataset as the primary substrate for analysis.

label: Bibliometric
description: Uses article, author, citation, venue, or institution metadata as the primary substrate.

label: Literature Review
description: Synthesizes findings from prior papers rather than deriving new estimates from a cohort.

label: Methods Simulation
description: Evaluates methods or algorithms and may use benchmark or simulated data when explicitly framed that way.

label: Theoretical Commentary
description: Argumentative or conceptual analysis without a primary dataset.
